execution.trigger: An explicit manual invocation with current scope
execution.overlap_policy: single active writer; no overlapping unattended runs
execution.notification: Final report or actionable blocker only

observed: artifact-read-write: isolated source snapshots and local reports exercised
resource-search: toolbox inventory and source inspection exercised
outcome-validation: test suite, frozen fixture contracts and independent evidence review
local-execution: Python fixture and CLI executed on macOS
rust-toolchain: optimized Rust fixture built and executed on macOS
github-read: connector identity and repository-list response shapes inspected; verify current host and account before use

authority.source: The current invoker must authorize the repositories and local actions for each run.
allowed: Run the local fixtures on request
Read repositories within the current authorized scope
Build and evaluate one isolated local candidate when authorized

retention.durable: Retain sources, candidates, raw evidence and reviews until explicit cleanup.
